verdict.rationale: Chronicle Labs is a SaaS agent-evaluation platform, so outbound webhooks are a fair capability to ask about. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Telemetry ingestion and OpenTelemetry export are inbound to Chronicle, events.search is a pull-style query, and recorded HTTP replays are simulation inputs, so none of these count as event subscriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
